Author: Krishan Pahal
Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1199 of 2023
Applicant :- Jasjeet Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Satya Prakash,Sunil Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sanjay Kumar Pundir Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
Heard Sri Sunil Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Sageer Ahmed, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Sri Sanjay Kumar Pundir, learned counsel for the informant as well as Sri Rajesh Kumar Srivastava, learned AGA for the State and also perused the material available on records.
The applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Case Crime No. 421 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC, Police Station- Sadar Bazar, District- Saharanpur.

As per prosecution story, the forefathers of the applicant, whose lineage the applicant belong to, has furnished a fake caste certificate claiming themselves to be of scheduled caste while they were of general category being Sikh by religion.
The applicant is stated to have enjoyed the said caste certificate himself also.
The District Level Committee is stated to have enquired into the matter and found that the said caste certificate was fake.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is an Advocate by profession and has not misused or used the said caste certificate anywhere.
The said forgery committed, if any, has been done by his forefathers and he is not at all responsible for it.
The charge-sheet has been submitted against the co-accused persons and the investigation is pending against them.
This court has granted interim protection till the submission of final report u/s 173(2) of Cr.P.C.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.

The circumstances which,
as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
The applicant is cooperating with the investigation and he is ready to do so in future.
There is no criminal history of the applicant and, therefore, he is entitled for protection from this Court.

Per contra, learned Senior Counsel for the informant as well as learned AGA have vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail on the ground that the applicant being an advocate is not entitled for any protection as he knows the nuisances of law and the said certificate could have been used by him somewhere.
Learned counsel for the informant has further stated that the applicant has taken advantage of the said certificate by getting himself admitted to LLB course.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the applicant deserves to be granted anticipatory bail in connection with the aforesaid case.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 Siddhant  Jasjeet Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100946677/
